_about: Losslessness-under-pressure experiment. Pre-registered scenario (scenario.json) run on real Claude subagents. A faithful 45-word summary (produced by a summarizer subagent, agent a40bc004) necessarily dropped some of the document's 8 facts; a downstream QA responder then answered 8 fixed questions under SUMMARY (sees summary only) vs TOAP (sees full document = lossless reference). 3 samples per arm. Verbatim outputs below; graded by deterministic substring check in grade.py.
